news.headline: US AI Data Centers ‘Are Going to Get Built’ Despite Political Pushback, Says Cisco CEO: ‘Too Important to Our Country’
news.summary: Cisco CEO Chuck Robbins says U.S. AI data centers will get built despite political pushback and sees no demand shift overseas.

news.headline: Cisco Systems Raises Fiscal 2027 Revenue Forecast
news.summary: Cisco Systems, Inc. has raised its annual revenue forecast for fiscal 2027, citing strong demand for its AI-powered networking solutions.

news.headline: Cisco Reports Fiscal 2027 First Quarter Financial Results
news.summary: Cisco Systems, Inc. announced record financial results for the first quarter of fiscal 2027, including $18.5 billion in revenue and $1.14 in GAAP earnings per share.

news.headline: NVIDIA Confirms South Korea GPU Supply Commitment
news.summary: NVIDIA has reaffirmed its commitment to supply 260,000 GPUs to South Korea for AI infrastructure projects despite the recent leadership transition.

news.headline: Jensen Huang Divorce Odds Hit 37%, but Top Lawyer Says Couple May Wait Out Scandal
news.summary: Jensen Huang divorce odds hit 37%, but top attorney Jacqueline Newman says the couple may have strong reasons to wait.

news.headline: Chamath Palihapitiya Says Nvidia Oversight Would Be A ‘Disaster’ After Jensen Huang's Exit, Warns Against Repeating Microsoft’s DOJ Era
news.summary: Chamath Palihapitiya warns Nvidia oversight after Jensen Huang’s exit could hurt U.S. AI leadership and repeat Microsoft’s DOJ era.

news.headline: Alphabet's Google Signs MoU with ENGIE for Potential French Data Center Energy Supply
news.summary: Google has entered into a memorandum of understanding with ENGIE to explore a potential energy supply agreement for a proposed data center project in France.

news.headline: Google Removes South Korean Map Coordinates to Comply with Security Permit
news.summary: Alphabet's Google has removed latitude and longitude coordinates for South Korean territory from its mapping services to meet security requirements set by a government export permit.

news.headline: Reported Earlier, South Korea Says Google Removed Map Coordinates, Will Delete Military And Security Facility Street View Imagery Under February Data Export Permit
National Pension Service of Korea Discloses Increase in SanDisk Shareholdings
news.summary: The National Pension Service (NPS) of Korea reported an increase in its stake in SanDisk Corporation, acquiring 169,196 additional shares during the third quarter.

news.headline: EXCLUSIVE: Jay Woods Names ‘Stock to Watch in 2027’ Amid Potential Democratic Big Tech Breakups
news.summary: Market expert Jay Woods makes a pick for the top stock to watch in 2027 based on the 2026 midterm elections.
